reason: Re-opened packet.js tanakh 60 --verse 11:18: Rashi on ושמתם את דברי says even after exile be marked by the commandments, put on tefillin, make mezuzot, so they are not new when you return (Sifrei); the paraphrase carries it without addition. Plain sense matches 11:16 to 17 (serve other gods, perish quickly from off the good land) and 11:18 to 20 restating the charge. Ramban on the verse quotes Rashi and adds that these are personal duties binding everywhere; that is a halakhic gloss on the Midrash, not a rival reading of the verse, so rule 5 does not require naming him.
